column1: # Characters accepted in a script although OpenCC would convert them.
# The script rule in tests/cbdb_desktop/i18n.py flags a character in
# Traditional text when every OpenCC conversion into Traditional changes
# it (and the same for Simplified).  Some such characters are nonetheless
# acceptable in that script by the maintainer's ruling; they are listed
# here and never flagged -- not on the pages, not on screen, not in the
# One character per line: script (traditional | simplified) <TAB>
# character <TAB> note.  Lines starting with # are comments.
